title: SEC3: Inconsistent state sync in Contact/changes event handler (app.js)
description: app.js lines 864-891: Contact/changes event handling is inconsistent with Message/Chat handlers. Message/Chat (lines 788-858) set state tokens before checking for errors, then sync from event data on error only (lines 820, 850). Contact handler sets contactState from result.newState (line 885) *after* the try-catch, without checking if result contains an error. If Contact/changes returns cannotCalculateChanges, state is synced from result instead of event data. This violates the error-recovery pattern used for Message/Chat. Better: Store result in variable, check for errors first, set state from event data on error (like Message/Chat lines 820, 850) or from result.newState on success. Brings Contact handling into alignment with Message/Chat patterns.
